title: Understanding the Problem
text: The file is divided into $$8$$ blocks, each replicated twice. Each block is stored on $$2$$ out of $$4$$ machines. If $$3$$ machines fail, can any block still be read?

title: Analyzing Block Storage
text: Each block is stored on $$2$$ machines. If $$3$$ machines fail, what is the probability that a block is still accessible?

title: Probability of Block Accessibility
text: For a block to be accessible, at least one of the two machines storing it must be operational. What is the probability of this happening?

title: Calculating Probability for One Block
text: Calculate the probability that at least one of the two machines storing a block is operational when $$3$$ machines fail.

title: Probability for All Blocks
text: What is the probability that all $$8$$ blocks are accessible?
